name: Rocket Stick - 1.2g Injected Pre Roll - Sour Green Apple
description:
Big flavor, extra kick. The Rocket Stick Sour Green Apple pre-roll is a 1.2-gram infused joint, packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. No device, no charging, just spark and go.

Sour Green Apple delivers a sharp candy punch: crisp, tart green apple up front with a mouth-watering sour snap that mellows into a smooth, sugary finish. It's a bold, taste-forward crowd-pleaser built for easy, flavorful sessions with an extra step up in strength.

Why you'll love it:

1.2G infused pre-roll — quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes for extra potency
Bold Sour Green Apple flavor — crisp, tart apple with a sweet candy finish
Smooth, even burn — flavorful from the first pull to the last
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in one ready-to-smoke joint. Rocket Stick Sour Green Apple is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
